human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Add a read-only CLI command for rebuilding if explicitly requested and rendering one stored run report as JSON or Markdown. Default behavior should read existing projection/report state without mutating raw evidence. Dependency: 8016.render-run-report.
human_pressure.why_now: Run Report should be usable before any web console exists.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Expose deterministic per-run governance report through the existing Ailuros CLI.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8016.render-run-report. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
contracts: Report output shape matches execution_report module.
failure_semantics: Missing run/projection is explicit nonzero state, not a governance block.

steps.title: Handle missing projection
details: Return actionable guidance to project/rebuild or support an explicit --rebuild option if chosen.
Do not silently build hidden derived state unless documented.

acceptance: One run can be rendered as JSON or Markdown.
Unknown run/projection returns nonzero actionable error.
No runtime tool calls are executed.

reject_if: Report command executes governed tools or recomputes runtime policy.
Missing projection is treated as clean run.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
